text_simplified: Allah grants to whom He wills females, and to whom He wills males, or He combines both for him, or makes him barren. Ibn al-Qayyim mentioned that one exposes oneself to Allah's contempt if a servant resents what Allah has bestowed upon him. Allah began by mentioning females, and it was said as consolation for them. Imam Ahmad, when a daughter was born to him, would say: 'The prophets were fathers of daughters.' He would say this to whoever was blessed with daughters, and their worry would leave. The author notes that some people's eyes are cooled by a single daughter, while another with many sons sees nothing but misery from them.
